tagline: Regional bank managing capital and risk across diverse client segments
hero_kpi_rationale: Significant growth in book value per share (+14% YoY), reflecting improved capital and financial performance, a key metric for regional banks.
company_description: KeyCorp operates as the holding company for KeyBank National Association that provides various retail and commercial banking products and services in the United States. It operates in two segments, Consumer Bank and Commercial Bank. The company offers various deposits and investment products; personal finance and financial wellness, lending, student loan refinancing, mortgage and home equity, credit card, treasury, and business advisory; commercial leasing, investment management, consumer finance; and wealth management and investment services for institutional, non-profit, and high-net-worth clients. It also provides lending, cash management, equipment financing, and commercial mortgage loans; and capital market products and services, such as syndicated finance, debt and equity underwriting, fixed income and equity sales and trading, derivatives, foreign exchange, mergers and acquisition, other advisory services, and public finance to large corporate and institutional clients. In addition, the company offers personal and institutional trust custody services, personal financial and planning services, access to mutual funds, treasury services, and international banking services. kpis.name: Book Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Shareholder equity divided by common shares outstanding
kpis.description: Book value per common share. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the last 7 years.

kpis.name: Tangible Book Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Book value excluding goodwill and intangible assets per share
kpis.description: Tangible book value per common share, excluding goodwill

kpis.name: Equity-to-Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Total equity divided by total assets, expressed as percentage
kpis.description: Ratio of equity to total assets, a financial strength indicator

kpis.name: Tangible Equity to Tangible Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tangible equity divided by tangible assets, expressed as percentage
kpis.description: Ratio of tangible equity to tangible assets, excluding goodwill

kpis.name: Tier 1 Risk-based Capital Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tier 1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets
kpis.description: Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio based on risk-weighted assets
kpis.signal: Regulatory ratio well above minimum requirements

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: CET1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets
kpis.description: Common Equity Tier 1 ratio based on risk-weighted assets

kpis.name: Total Risk-based Capital Ratio
kpis.explanation: Total capital divided by risk-weighted assets
kpis.description: Total risk-based capital ratio based on risk-weighted assets

kpis.name: Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tier 1 capital divided by average total assets adjusted
kpis.description: Regulatory leverage ratio (Tier 1 capital over adjusted average total assets)

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.205 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $1.054 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 57.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Cyberattacks and Data Breaches
risks.summary: Ongoing threat of cyberattacks that could compromise customer and operational data security.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K with strong language on persistent and sophisticated threats. The risk is repeated across multiple sections including governance and incident management. Increased vigilance compared to prior year with regular exercises. Highly critical category for a financial institution. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Non-compliance with Cybersecurity Regulations
risks.summary: Risk of sanctions or costs related to failure to comply with cybersecurity and data protection regulatory standards.
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions compliance with GLBA and mandatory regulatory examinations. The language indicates increased pressure from regulators. Risk amplified by the highly regulated nature of the banking sector. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Failure in Third-Party Vendor Controls
risks.summary: Increased vulnerability due to security weaknesses in poorly managed external vendors.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed in third-party management with due diligence and periodic reviews. The intensity of language highlights growing exposure through service providers. Cybersecurity category reinforces severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Internal Security Controls Failure
risks.summary: Risk of inadequacy or failure of internal controls despite formal review processes.
risks.score_rationale: The security program relies on three lines of defense. Internal audits identify gaps corrected under supervision. The system is robust but operational dependency is total. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Business Disruption Following a Major Incident
risks.summary: Severe operational disruption possible in case of a successful attack not contained quickly.
risks.score_rationale: The recovery plan is described in detail with dedicated emergency teams. The risk is considered critical but mitigated by regular testing. Strategic position within governance. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Inadequate Management of Technology Innovation Risks
risks.summary: Exposure to failures or unexpected costs related to the integration of new technologies.
risks.score_rationale: The Technology Committee oversees strategic investments, but the risk of adopting evolving technologies is implied. Language is cautious but not alarming. Less critical than other cybersecurity risks. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: KeyCorp does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
